title: Three AI Vendors, Four Selection Criteria
annotation: No vendor wins on every axis. Vendor A is cheapest but weakest on privacy; Vendor C has the best output and the worst cost fit.
insight: A radar chart cannot tell you which vendor to pick, because that depends on which axis your club cares about. Choose a priority below and the ranking updates - the point being that the ranking changes with the priority, which is why a club has to state its priority before comparing vendors.
